verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own docs say each connector handles schema changes automatically, which covers detecting and propagating upstream schema changes rather than letting loads break. Nothing in the evidence shows a user-selectable schema-change policy (e.g., allow all, block new columns, or require review), so the 'by a policy I choose' part is unevidenced. missing for 10: configurable schema-change policy options, documentation of how changes are detected and propagated, alerting on schema changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, upstream schema changes are detected and propagated by a policy I choose, instead of silently breaking loads

citations.quote: Each connector handles schema changes, API updates, and incremental syncs automatically — no data pipelines to maintain.
